title: Commercial mining pilot tests of the SAR technique under NDA

tellings.quote: I did a lot of pilot tests with companies. Uh-huh. And uh more than 100% successful.

plain: The radar researcher Filippo Biondi says he tested his SAR technique for mining companies under nondisclosure agreements. SAR, or synthetic aperture radar, is a satellite radar imaging method, and it is the same technique he used to claim there are structures beneath the Egyptian pyramids. He tells Michels he did "a lot of pilot tests with companies" and that they were "more than 100% successful", which he offers as proof that the method can really see underground.
